local.hash_policy: known text extensions use recorded sha256_lf; binary inputs use recorded raw sha256; output hashes are exact Git blob hashes
local.scope_note: Core source snapshots cover portable C/C++ inputs and included case snapshots; matching Objective-C++ case hashes is not Session/native execution. Assets/browser comparison uses explicit command dependencies, excluding unrelated C++ captured by their broad recorder. All selected local phases ran on the 0.5.40 candidate; Objective-C++ execution is verified by the separately pinned CI run.

retained_evidence.scope: Local portable core, Android compilation, browser and recorded-board evidence keep original execution commit/times. Only identical dependencies are associated with corrected candidate; Session changes require the final complete CI run.

android.scope: NDK 27, API 26 static core compilation only; no APK build or Android runtime tests

recorded_board.scope: Offline public solver calls; actual Session and native input covered separately by CI fixtures

reviewed_screenshots.observations: 320px narrow browser view: selected icon, label, unsaved notice and fixed save button visible; no clipped controls.
390px browser view: expanded icon grid, labels and scroll region render correctly; save button remains visible.
390px browser with reduced viewport: focused card search, navigation and result text fit the visible area; continued content remains scrollable.

390px full-page browser: failed-write message and retained newer draft are visible, six slots fit the width, and unknown badge 255 remains preserved. The fixed save bar appears mid-image in the full-page capture; local scrolled badge captures separately verify access to those controls.

iPhone Scene window, scrolled formation view: awakening icon totals and expandable sections fit the width; fixed Save is visible and Apply is disabled outside an eligible solo window. This capture does not show the badge selector.

iPhone legacy window after restart: saved team B, six body slots and assist portraits render correctly; native target waiting text and disabled Apply remain visible. Lower content is scrollable below the fixed save bar.

iPhone orb preview: all 6x5 cells, route line, step slider, coordinates and execute/continuous/stop controls are visible without horizontal clipping. The fixture preview does not constitute game execution.

visual.scope: Selected local badge screenshots, current-CI browser screenshots and iPhone Scene/legacy restart/route-preview screenshots reviewed. Four iPhone GUI reports passed. No real-device review.
